content_zh:
这个罗峰竟然敢到他家捣乱，打他的保镖。
“小心点，这家伙腿脚重的很。”跌倒在地的矮胖保镖揉了揉肚子，嘴角都有血迹渗出，一时间竟然爬不起来。
“小子，够狠的啊。”那姓王的保镖和另外一名保镖都朝罗峰迅速围过去，见识过刚才罗峰的一脚之力，这两名保镖也根本不敢大意。而罗峰这时候已经冲到了父亲罗洪国身旁，可还没来得及说话，罗洪国连道：“我没事，小峰，小心后面！”
几乎一瞬间两名保镖一左一右，同时进攻向罗峰。而且那张昊白也悄悄逼迫过来。
三人联手！
“哼！”罗峰眼角余光瞥了一下，瞬间一个转身，通过腰胯借着这股旋转力道，迅速的挥出了右臂，同时竖掌成刀。整个右臂小臂就仿佛一柄战刀瞬间横斩切过！
手刀未到，劲风已经吹来。
“不好。”姓王的保镖面色一变，立即双臂去抵挡罗峰这一记横切！
蓬！低沉撞击声。
罗峰的手刀重重的斩在姓王的保镖双臂上。
姓王的保镖只感觉自己的双臂就仿佛不是自己的一般，疼痛到瞬间失去感觉，只感觉右前臂一阵无力，不由迅速后退同时嘶声喊道：“我右臂骨折了！”
“什么！”准备动手的张昊白大吃一惊，他家的这三个保镖可都是武馆高级学员，按道理罗峰是武馆高级学员，力量上应该相差不大，不可能一记手刀就斩的同是武馆高级学员的那名王姓保镖的右臂骨折。
“不好！”姓王的保镖受伤，只剩下那名身材高大的黑衣保镖了，这黑衣保镖的两位伙伴接连被击败，一时间他又惊又怒。
黑衣保镖一咬牙，低吼一声就是闪电般一脚外加一拳。
嗖！嗖！
罗峰却灵活的很，两个晃动就已经避开了两次攻击，随后毫不留情的就是一记最猛烈的劈刀！
右手高高举起，就仿佛关公刀猛烈下劈！
“太快了。”躲避不及的黑衣保镖只能双手架在上方，咬牙硬抗这一劈！当罗峰那可怕的一记手刀疯狂劈下时，黑衣保镖心中已经有了畏惧之心。
黑衣保镖只感觉双臂瞬间失去直觉，竟然直接被罗峰的一记手刀砸的双臂一软，而罗峰这一记手刀却根本不减气势，压着黑衣保镖的双臂又砸在了黑衣保镖的肩膀上，超过千斤的力道瞬间让保镖整个人跪坐在地上。
“怎么可能？”本来准备偷袭的张昊白，吓得停下了。

三大保镖，一个捂着肚子爬不起来，一个右臂骨折，还有一个被一记手刀劈的跪在地上！
“张昊白！”罗峰双眸欲喷火，要吃人一样。
“你干什么。罗峰，你要干什么！”张昊白猛地连退两步，怒吼道，“这是我家！你擅闯民宅，还打伤我的人，你还嚣张！”
“竟然敢打我爸，敢踹我爸！”罗峰双拳紧握，全身肌肉就仿佛钢筋一般，青筋更是如蚯蚓般一突一突的，显得那般狰狞。
“你爸，你爸是谁我都不知道，我怎么打你爸，踹你……”张昊白忽然一瞪眼，看向远处身上脏兮兮的，还满是脚印的三名工人。他一下子明白了，为什么罗峰不问其他就直接冲进来打人了。
张昊白看着要吃人的罗峰，立即大吼道：“罗峰，我警告你，你——”
“蓬！”
罗峰凌厉的一脚，快如闪电的一脚直接踹在张昊白的肚子上，令张昊白直接被踢得趴在地上，脸色涨红。
“警告个屁！”罗峰一把就抓住张昊白的颈部衣服，将他给一把抓了起来，令张昊白整个人都悬空。
“你，你……”张昊白想说话，可是抓住颈部衣服整个人悬空，这令他颈部压力很大，呼吸起来都难受的很，更别说说话了。
“快把业主放下来！”
一道怒喝声老远就传来，只见十数名保安全副武装，一个个拿着警戒棍冲了过来。天都小区内很多地方都有摄像头，这里发生的打斗第一瞬间就被小区保安们给知道了，能住在小区联排别墅的都不是一般人家，他们哪敢大意。
第一时间就立即赶来，同时也报警了。
罗峰瞥了一眼冲过来的小区保安们，冷笑看了一眼张昊白，随手一扔，张昊白直接跌在庭院的草坪上，身上的白色衣服早就被草汁给染绿了。
“爸，没事吧？”罗峰走到父亲罗洪国身边。

content_en:
This Luo Feng actually dared to go to his house to cause trouble and beat up his bodyguard.
"Be careful, this guy's legs and feet are very heavy." The short and fat bodyguard fell to the ground and rubbed his belly. There was blood oozing from the corners of his mouth, and he couldn't get up for a while.
"Boy, you are so cruel." The bodyguard surnamed Wang and another bodyguard quickly surrounded Luo Feng. Having seen the force of Luo Feng's kick just now, these two bodyguards did not dare to be careless at all. Luo Feng had already rushed to his father Luo Hongguo's side at this time, but before he could speak, Luo Hongguo said: "I'm fine, Xiaofeng, be careful behind you!"
Almost instantly, two bodyguards, one on the left and one on the right, attacked Luo Feng at the same time. And Zhang Haobai also quietly forced himself over.
Three people join forces!
"Hmph!" Luo Feng glanced out of the corner of his eye, turned around in an instant, and using the rotation force from his waist, he quickly swung his right arm out and raised his palm into a knife. The entire right arm and forearm felt like a sword slashing across it in an instant!
Before the hand knife arrived, the strong wind was already blowing.
"Not good." The face of the bodyguard named Wang changed, and he immediately used his arms to block Luo Feng's crosscut!
Peng! A low crashing sound.
Luo Feng's knife struck heavily on the arms of the bodyguard named Wang.
The bodyguard named Wang felt as if his arms were not his own. He was so painful that he lost all feeling in an instant. He only felt a weakness in his right forearm. He couldn't help but quickly retreated and shouted in a hissing voice: "My right arm is broken!"
"What!" Zhang Haobai, who was about to take action, was shocked. The three bodyguards of his family were all senior students of the martial arts school. Logically speaking, Luo Feng was a senior student of the martial arts school. There should be about the same strength. It was impossible to kill the bodyguard surnamed Wang, who was also a senior student of the martial arts school, with a single stroke of his hand. His right arm was broken.
"Not good!" The bodyguard surnamed Wang was injured, and only the tall bodyguard in black was left. The two partners of the bodyguard in black were defeated one after another, and he was shocked and angry for a while.
The bodyguard in black gritted his teeth, roared, and kicked and punched like lightning.
Whoosh! Whoosh!
Luo Feng was very flexible. He had already avoided two attacks with just two swings, and then came the most violent chopping blow without mercy!
Raise your right hand high, as if Guan Gong's sword is slashing violently!
"Too fast." The bodyguard in black, unable to dodge, could only put his hands above his head and gritted his teeth to resist the blow! When Luo Feng's terrifying knife slashed down wildly, the black-clothed bodyguard already felt fear in his heart.
The black-clothed bodyguard felt his arms lose consciousness for an instant, and his arms were knocked weak by Luo Feng's knife. However, Luo Feng's hand-knife did not reduce his momentum at all. The arms that were pressing down on the black-clothed bodyguard hit the black-clothed bodyguard's shoulders again. The force of more than a thousand kilograms instantly made the bodyguard kneel on the ground.
"How is that possible?" Zhang Haobai, who was about to make a sneak attack, stopped in fear.
Of the three bodyguards, one was clutching his stomach and couldn't get up, one had a broken right arm, and the other was kneeling on the ground after being struck by a knife!
"Zhang Haobai!" Luo Feng's eyes were filled with fire, as if he wanted to eat people.
"What are you doing? Luo Feng, what are you going to do!" Zhang Haobai took two steps back suddenly and roared, "This is my home! You broke into a house without permission and injured my people, and you are so arrogant!"
"You dare to hit my dad, you dare to kick my dad!" Luo Feng clenched his fists tightly, his muscles all over his body were like steel bars, and the veins were protruding like earthworms, making him look so ferocious.
"Your dad, I don't even know who your dad is. How can I beat your dad or kick you..." Zhang Haobai suddenly glared and looked at the three workers in the distance who were dirty and covered with footprints. He suddenly understood why Luo Feng rushed in and beat people without asking anything else.
Zhang Haobai looked at Luo Feng who was about to eat people, and immediately shouted: "Luo Feng, I'm warning you, you-"
"Peng!"
Luo Feng's sharp kick, as fast as lightning, kicked directly on Zhang Haobai's stomach, causing Zhang Haobai to be kicked to the ground and his face turned red.
"warnShit! "Luo Feng grabbed Zhang Haobai's clothes by the neck and grabbed him, leaving Zhang Haobai hanging in the air.
"You, you..." Zhang Haobai wanted to speak, but he grabbed the clothes around his neck and hung him in the air. This put a lot of pressure on his neck and made it very uncomfortable to breathe, let alone speak.
“Put the owner down quickly! "
An angry shout came from afar, and dozens of security guards were seen rushing over, each armed with a baton. There are cameras in many places in the Tiandu Community. The fights that occurred here were immediately known to the security guards of the community. The people who can live in the townhouses in the community are not ordinary people. How can they dare to be careless.
He came immediately and called the police.
Luo Feng glanced at the community security guards who rushed over, glanced at Zhang Haobai with a sneer, and threw it away. Zhang Haobai fell directly on the lawn of the courtyard. His white clothes had long been dyed green by the grass juice.
"Dad, are you okay? "Luo Feng walked to his father Luo Hongguo.
